Service Workerによる高速キャッシュと通信遮断時の継続動作: Fast caching with Service Worker and seamless offline operation
初回アクセス時、アプリのHTML、CSS、JavaScript、アイコン、および: On your first visit, app HTML, CSS, JavaScript, icons, and tour data (schedule, companies, etc.) are pre-downloaded into Cache Storage. This allows instant display even in subways or tour buses without connectivity.
単にService Workerが登録されただけでは準備完了とはみなしません。内: Registration alone is not treated as ready. Through internal communication (MessageChannel), the app verifies each cached file one by one to ensure all required assets are stored before showing the ready badge.
安全な更新フロー（更新待機と手動反映）: Safe update flow (waiting and manual activation)
新しいバージョンが公開されると、裏側で静かに最新データをダウンロードして待機状態: When an update is released, it is downloaded in the background into a waiting state. To avoid discarding ongoing notes, the app never auto-reloads; it notifies you and activates only when you tap 'Apply update'.
配布資料などの大容量PDFファイルは、端末のストレージを過剰に消費しないよう、S: Large PDF handouts are excluded from Service Worker caching to save local storage. An active internet connection is required to open PDF documents.
企業メモ・事前学習データの保存と保護: Storage and Protection of Company Notes & Learning Data
端末内完結のlocalStorageによるプライバシーと消失防止ガード: Device-local localStorage privacy and unsaved data protection guards
企業詳細ページで入力したメモや、事前学習のチェック状態は、外部サーバーに一切送信: Company notes and learning checklist states are never sent to external servers. Everything is saved locally in localStorage, allowing private and free note-taking even when completely offline.
未保存データの保護ガード（多重セーフティ）: Multiple safety guards for unsaved data
万一、端末の空き容量不足などで保存に失敗した場合は、内部で「未保存フラグ」を立て: If saving fails due to full storage, an unsaved flag is raised with an on-screen warning. Closing or refreshing triggers a beforeunload prompt, and PWA updates are blocked to prevent data loss.
データはお使いのブラウザ専用に保存されるため、異なるブラウザや他人の端末には共有: Data is isolated to your specific browser and never shared with other browsers or devices. Clearing browsing data will erase notes. You can also manually reset data anytime in Settings.
